title: Seeing Depth but Choosing Cues in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.17976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Do vision-language models use depth information to judge which object is closer, or rely on image-plane cues? We investigate this question through controlled depth--cue conflicts, representation analysis, and interventions. Among the many image-plane cues relevant to depth perception, we focus on apparent size and vertical position. We compare depth judgments under cue-consistent and cue-conflict conditions in both rendered scenes and real-world photographs. Across model families and scales, depth judgments systematically shift toward misleading cues. Yet the correct depth order remains decodable from the queried objects' visual representations, including when the model answers incorrectly. Image and category controls support interpreting this signal as image-dependent depth information beyond the two target cues. translated_title: 视觉语言模型：能“看见”深度，却选择依赖线索
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型是利用深度信息来判断哪个物体更近，还是依赖图像平面上的线索？我们通过受控的深度-线索冲突实验、表征分析和干预手段来研究这个问题。在与深度感知相关的众多图像平面线索中，我们聚焦于表观大小和垂直位置。我们在渲染场景和真实照片中，比较了线索一致与线索冲突条件下的深度判断。研究发现，跨越不同模型家族和模型规模，深度判断都会系统性地偏向误导性线索。然而，即使在模型回答错误时，正确的深度顺序仍然可以从被查询物体的视觉表征中解码出来。图像和类别层面的对照实验支持将这一信号解释为超越这两个目标线索的、依赖于图像的深度信息。通过对象级回写来增强模型自身的深度读出，可以在不更新模（型权重的情况下）纠正冲突情境下的错误判断。【注：原摘要在此处截断】
tldr: 研究发现视觉语言模型在判断物体远近时会被表观大小、垂直位置等图像平面线索系统性误导，但其内部表征中实际编码了正确的深度顺序信息，且通过对象级回写增强模型的深度读出即可纠正这类错误判断，无需更新模型权重。
en_tdlr: Vision-language models systematically rely on misleading image-plane cues (apparent size and vertical position) for depth judgments, even though the correct depth order is decodable from their internal visual representations, and strengthening the depth readout via object-level write-back can correct these conflict errors without updating model weights.
